name: cmdgate
description: A second opinion on Cursor Agent shell commands: safe/unsafe, risk level, dangerous and root access, from your locally running Command Gate app.

CMDGATE_ENDPOINT.title: Backend endpoint
CMDGATE_ENDPOINT.description: Decision API endpoint of the locally running Command Gate app.

CMDGATE_MODEL.title: Model
CMDGATE_MODEL.description: Value sent as `model` in each request, to pick one of the app's models.

CMDGATE_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Timeout (ms)
CMDGATE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: How long to wait for the app before saying there is no answer.

CMDGATE_THRESHOLD.title: Yes threshold
CMDGATE_THRESHOLD.description: Probability at or above which a yes/no answer reads as yes.

CMDGATE_FORWARD_TO_IDE.title: Forward to IDE add-ons
CMDGATE_FORWARD_TO_IDE.description: Also send each result to IDE add-ons listening on this machine (e.g. the Command Gate VS Code add-on). Set to "false" to disable.
